item.title: 2 Minute Medicine Rewind September 7, 2026
item.description: A study found that higher maternal body mass index (BMI) was linked to increased cardiovascular risk in offspring.

item.title: EVAOLD trial provides guidance on treating older patients after a heart attack
item.description: The EVAOLD trial suggests that a routine invasive approach remains preferable to a selective one for older patients with the most common type of heart attack.

item.title: BRCA Mutation Carriers Likely to Have Risk-Reducing Surgery
item.description: A study of about 4,000 women with pathogenic variants in breast cancer susceptibility genes examined their uptake of risk-reducing surgeries.

item.title: Experimental cancer drug could help millions of women battling osteoporosis and midlife weight gain
item.description: New research from the University of East Anglia suggests an experimental cancer drug may help prevent osteoporosis and support weight management after menopause.
